categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Touches wallet fee-bumping and transaction creation logic in `src/wallet/feebumper.cpp` and `src/wallet/spend.cpp` with the Wallet label.
categories.rationale: Prevents replacement transactions generated via `bumpfee` from receiving an `nLockTime` earlier than the original transaction, eliminating an on-chain fingerprint caused by anti-fee-sniping backdating. While transaction privacy and fingerprinting matter in the wallet, this is a minor anomaly rather than an urgent fund-safety or privacy defect.
